data.title: Will the Clarity Act be signed into law in 2026?
data.description:
This market tracks whether the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act of 2025 (H.R. 3633), commonly known as the CLARITY Act, is passed by the U.S. Congress and signed into law.

### **Market Dates:**

- **Market Period:** From the publication date until December 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM ET.
- **Market Close:** December 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM ET.
- **Resolution Time:** Upon official confirmation that the bill has been signed into law, or after Market Close if it has not been.

### **Resolution Criteria:**

- Resolves to "**Yes**" if the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act of 2025 (H.R. 3633) is passed by both chambers of the U.S. Congress and signed into law by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.
- Resolves to "**No**" if the bill has not been passed by both chambers of Congress and signed into law by that time.

### **Resolution Details:**

- The primary resolution source for this market is [Congress.gov](http://Congress.gov)'s legislation tracker for H.R. 3633.
- A consensus of other credible reporting from official U.S. government sources may also be used to resolve this market.
- Amendments, renumbering, or renaming of the bill that preserve its substantive digital asset market structure provisions will not affect resolution, provided the legislation is signed into law within the Market Period.

### **Cancellation Conditions:**

- The U.S. Congress is not in session or unable to conduct legislative business for a prolonged period during the Market Period.
- Any circumstance makes it impossible to determine the outcome definitively using the specified criteria.

If the market is cancelled, participants can claim their stakes at the then-current market value of their shares, which could result in a profit or a loss depending on the price of those shares at cancellation.

data.title: BTC above $80,000 on October 25, 4PM UTC?
data.description:
### **Market Details:**

- **Market Period:** From the publication date through October 25, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC.
- **Market Close:** October 25, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC.
- **Resolution Time:** October 25, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC.

### **Market Targets:**

- This event contains multiple independent BTC/USDT Market Targets.
- Each Market Target resolves independently as either "**Yes**" or "**No**".

### **Resolution Criteria:**

- Resolves to "**Yes**" if the Binance BTC/USDT spot price is above the respective Market Target at Resolution Time.
- Resolves to "**No**" if the Binance BTC/USDT spot price is equal to or below the respective Market Target at Resolution Time.

### **Resolution Details:**

- Only the Binance BTC/USDT spot price chart will be considered, specifically:
  - **One minute candles ("1m")**
  - **"Trading View"**
  - **"Close" price**

### **Cancellation Conditions:**

- The BTC/USDT spot market on Binance is suspended or becomes unreliable.
- The Binance platform is unavailable or experiences significant disruptions during the Market Period.
- Any circumstance prevents reliable price tracking during the Market Period.

If the market is cancelled, participants can claim their stakes at the then-current market value of their shares, which could result in a profit or a loss depending on the price of those shares at cancellation.

data.title: Patriots vs. Bears: Who wins?
data.description:
### **Market Dates:**

- **Market Period:** From the publication date until October 24, 2026, at 00:15 UTC.
- **Market Close:** October 24, 2026, at 00:15 UTC, 24 hours after the game is scheduled to start.
- **Resolution Deadline:** The resolution will be determined after the results are published on the resolution source.

### **Resolution Criteria:**

- Resolves to “**Patriots**” if the New England Patriots win the game.
- Resolves to “**Bears**” if the Chicago Bears win.

### **Resolution Details:**

- This market refers to the Week 7 game between the **New England Patriots** and the **Chicago Bears** scheduled to begin on October 22, 2026, at 8:15 PM ET.
- If the game is postponed but played within the same “Week 7” window (NFL definition), the result still counts.
- If the game ends in a tie, this market will resolve in favor of the team that scored last.

### **Cancellation Conditions:**

- The game is cancelled, postponed indefinitely, or held outside of the same “Week 7” window (NFL definition).
- The game ends in a 0:0 tie.
- Any circumstance makes it impossible to determine the outcome definitively.
- The resolution source is suspended, becomes unreliable or fails to provide an outcome.

If the market is cancelled, participants can claim their stakes at the then-current market value of their shares, which could result in a profit or a loss depending on the price of those shares at cancellation.
